Class Controller

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameMessageVisitor
public class Controller extends Object implements GameMessageVisitor
Controller class that handles messages sent by clients during the game.

Implements the GameMessageVisitor interface using the Visitor pattern to process different types of client messages and forward them to the game model via ApplicableActions.
